task_description: Build the Ledger OCR MVP: multi-tenant Next.js 16 PWA for a Dutch accountant managing Latino ZZP clients. NextAuth v5 roles (ACCOUNTANT/CLIENT), client invitation/activation, categories, manual + OCR-assisted expense creation with GPT-4o Vision + Jev/TypeSafe classification (confidence-gated, no auto-approval), accountant review workflow, CSV export, next-intl (es/nl/en), Serwist PWA. Keep a working build (lint + tsc --noEmit + next build green) at every stage.
